comments.comment: As a skilled immigrant to Germany, and i a person with lots of skilled immigrants in the friend circle, i can say a few things 1. please make the bureaucracy easier , please go digital.. its papers and letters every where its inconvenient. 2.Again make your banks digital, the banking is still decade behind, push for complete access to digital payments.. its so annoying that some places only accept cash, i am from a generation who hates paper money and Germany force me to have it with me. 3. At least in the south of Germany even the supermarkets close at 8:00 pm.. why? 😥 its 2023. 4. the housing is getting too expensive in the cities.  But there are good too. 1. working hear is so satisfying and fulfilling.. the working culture is excellent.. people work to live not the other way.. its taken very seriously here. Compared to other locations of our company we in Germany enjoy much more flexibility. 2.    50 Euros per month and travel the whole country(there are stuff to improve but the opportunity is immensely appreciated )  3.  The people are nice.. you can find occasionally some people who try to harass you but its a small minority and believe me  Germany harassment is more of a funny joke than what we grew up in . But most people are very welcoming and even very happy when they know you are trying to speak German (not have to be good at it ) 4. beers... oh man oh man oh man the south knows how to brew.. beer varieties are countless..(please don't argue on this point, i don't like to ) ya this is what came to my mind... you can do whatever you wand with this....
